new.n: Louis Schmidt's missing $7,000 in jars and crocks, 653 W. Third St., Winona
new.pl: 653 W. Third St., Winona (Winona County address point, parcel 320701550)
new.st: Louis Schmidt, a Chicago & North Western machinist and hoarder, hid about $14,800 in jars and crocks under his house at 653 W. Third St. In early 1933 relatives, attorneys and a police officer dug for it: nephew Alfred Priewert recovered $2,610 (9 Mar), niece Mrs. Emma McKenzie $2,770 (22 Mar), and a First National Bank crew $1,785 in gold (13 May) from a crock holding a pint fruit jar about 4 ft down. Court evidence showed about $7,000 still unaccounted for. The pin is today's Winona County address point for 653 W. 3rd St., set from the parcel. Winona house numbers could have changed since 1933, which a city directory would confirm.
new.t: Urban private lot with an exact address: story pin only, LOOK-ONLY. The house may still stand; the rest of the money may have been quietly taken in 1933.
src: Winona Daily News 27 Oct 1933 p1 "$7,000 of Hoarded Gold Still Missing, Evidence in Schmidt Case Shows" (newspapers.com image 547047918, PC read). Single source: C
